## Source: amazon-inspector (85125cc2bc8e39e151e11ee36382b5d2e2167dfb215e654ade236e46b783b062)
Package quasitonnts version 0.1.0 on PyPI was examined and no code paths performing credential access, outbound network I/O to attacker-controlled destinations, install-time or import-time code execution, dropper behavior, or persistence were identified in its shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (6b73744742a9129ba02b40242325d596780af7d8e456c7040e8458d29c125540)
The package belongs to a series of packages falsely advertising 'audio-analysis profiles' loader. In fact, the only purpose is to execute remote code, but the URL is not embedded in the package. It is likely a continuation of the coin-mining campaign 2026-10-voxeval which used similar wording.
